parts.text: Use a subsequent filing under the existing job number—not a new unrelated job number—for the later plumbing scope, assuming it is part of the same construction project and property. The guide says all filings for the same construction project should share the job number with the appropriate filing extension.

reviewedDeliveredProjection.answerText:
No. A filing representative cannot attest for the applicant or owner, and cannot submit the job filing. The applicant must complete the Applicant of Record’s attestation and electronic signature before submission; the owner must complete the Owner’s Attestation to authorize the applicant to submit and acknowledge review of the application. The applicant reviews, gives the final electronic signature, and officially submits the job filing to the Department. [DOB NOW application user guide, p. 38](https://www.nyc.gov/assets/buildings/pdf/dob_now_application_user_guide.pdf#page=38) [DOB NOW: Build FAQs — Owner and Professional Responsibilities](https://www.nyc.gov/site/buildings/industry/dob-now-build-faqs.page) [Filing through DOB NOW: Build — attestation, preview and submission](https://www.nyc.gov/site/buildings/property-or-business-owner/filing-through-dob-now-build.page)

If the Owner Type is Condo Unit Owner or Co-Op Tenant-Shareholder, the Board representative must also log in and complete the Board attestation; both the owner’s and Board representative’s attestations are required before the filing can proceed. [DOB NOW: Build release notes, p. 20](https://www.nyc.gov/assets/buildings/pdf/dob_now_build_release_notes.pdf#page=20)

Official supporting guidance — noncontrolling and not an enacted-code conclusion.
